
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/piaomiaohongchen/p/19148914" title="发布于 2025-11-02 19:39">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">CSPT漏洞浅析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">CSPT全称是<span class="style-bold">Client-Side Path Traversal ，即客户端路径遍历。</span></span></div>
<div id="_nCRiiBOV" class="editor-block text-block hover" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">概念说明</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_FgYxuL92" class="editor-block code-block empty-block editor-code-highlighted" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code">
<div class="block-content">
<div id="_0Z6V9jlf" class="editor-container sub-container" data-node-type="container">
<div id="_U4q5fib6" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">CSPT 全称 Client-Side Path Traversal（客户端路径遍历），是一种针对前端应用的漏洞，核心是攻击者通过篡改 URL 参数、请求参数等，让浏览器（客户端）错误地向非预期的服务器路径发送请求，从而获取本不应访问的数据或资源。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_VepjN1sF" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">它的本质是 “前端逻辑对参数校验不严格”，区别于传统的 “服务端路径遍历”（攻击目标是服务器文件系统）：</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_vZ8552j3" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">攻击对象：浏览器的请求逻辑（而非服务器）；</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_AnmcTlmX" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">核心结果：让浏览器请求到开发者未开放的 API 接口、JSON 数据文件等；</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_q1L04Mc3" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">如果配合其他漏洞，可能会触发或绕过达成某些漏洞的利用，多用于chain二次攻击。</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_NE9txWoF" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_alOphQMZ" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">跟上我的节奏，让我们揭开这个漏洞的神秘面纱。漏洞基本特征:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_8mXkVLfg" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">浏览器上访问 用户资料页面:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_tJGh9lLg" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1</a></div>
</div>
<div id="_lNdIu1Z8" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="393">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193507343-1822346949.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_wHUUODTJ" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">除了触发本身的前端页面外，还会触发一个api接口</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_EDjoEe28" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">api接口: http://localhost:9999/api/users/1</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_s6XLbnUM" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">response返回:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_9I3GeZis" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="92">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193520136-2043014513.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_ICw1C37I" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">api接口会把返回映射返回给前端输出响应。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_TnKPROjU" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">用一张图总结下此特征:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_5MCAVYdG" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="223">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193533818-409111216.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_IX7S02kz" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_kg7NtDVR" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">修改id=123</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_hTpLX8Bz" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=123" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=123</a></div>
</div>
<div id="_Y_OtsWmg" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="383">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193543342-1042678174.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_x8Gtj3P7" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">后端会去尝试请求:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_3LenCRf9" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">http://localhost:9999/api/users/123</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_5ntreoqw" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_mBIUi6In" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">那么这里大家发现没有，我们发现api路径上的id可控，即可</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_RoDvum0W" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/api/users/{可控" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/api/users/{可控</a><span class="editor-text-node">}</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_IoNfETEO" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">有这个特征，那么我们可以做什么？</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_K8LMhsMY" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">输入<a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=../123" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=../123</a></span></div>
</div>
<div id="_GwXg5j0m" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="446">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193554850-1204754077.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_v4bU7SDl" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_rE3wAS59" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">api会去请求http://localhost:9999/api/123</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_qcrAdyTt" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">现在我们通过客户端(前端)的访问，<span class="style-bold">任意控制后端api的路由走向<span class="editor-text-node">。</span></span></span></div>
</div>
<div id="_8vlWoM6y" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">单看CSPT漏洞，感觉这种行为没有任何意义。因为我们用户本身就可以访问api接口。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_lIiGaPIC" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">现在我们把CSPT代入到CSRF漏洞</span></div>
</div>
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="style-bold">可用业务场景1:</span></div>
<div id="_mSCoTzTj" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">用户访问</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_UUVXInZd" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1</a></div>
</div>
<div id="_n0Np2_EG" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="304">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193609197-435121736.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_wJLPyAum" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_7BTfIb9G" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">输出用户信息 如id 姓名和头像。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_RZbnPF42" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_qvLL88dm" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">站点内，我们发现了一个get请求的修改用户姓名的接口如下所示:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_ixHhCEJ3" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/api/profile?id=1&amp;name=test" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/api/profile?id=1&amp;name=test</a></div>
</div>
<div id="_ByE4le_o" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">当我们直接访问他，它存在安全限制，csrf最常见的安全修复方案就是referer限制。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_seaIcIO2" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193623802-1093474749.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_zvujkAXb" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">因为有referer限制，我无法csrf修改用户信息成功。那么此时CSPT漏洞的作用就来了。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_aXMiqm_V" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">已知:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_bqdUQrv0" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1</a></div>
</div>
<div id="_ScUSDBFy" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">返回接口:http://localhost:9999/api/users/1</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_AzKsHQFQ" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">构造可以csrf的CSPT接口:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_qvTNgVcP" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=</a><span class="editor-text-node">../<a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/api/profile?id=1&amp;name=test" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">profile?id=1&amp;name=test</a></span></div>
</div>
<div id="_G11nEvV9" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">因为是客户端漏洞，所以最好有必要对特殊字符串进行url编码下:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_32xb_skE" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=</a><span class="editor-text-node">..%2f<a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/api/profile?id=1&amp;name=test" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">profile%3fid%3d1%26name%3dtest</a></span></div>
</div>
<div id="_kyk4_CbM" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">使用浏览器再次访问:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_sQGMA6ur" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="297">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193632920-280044989.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_Ob1gN5CA" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">此时利用CSPT，我们成功绕过了csrf限制，通过网络数据请求，你能看到他携带了referer。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_ZQa5_HvY" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">现在我们刷新我们的id=1的用户页面:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_4X80J05W" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="395">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193642364-1252056137.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_fjLMZ4Yq" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">此时姓名已经被修改掉了，说明csrf成功。比起传统的referer url绕过，使用CSPT更加方便，更加智能。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_Z0KUL2DP" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">可用业务场景2:</span></div>
<div id="_cHj_B7aa" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">如果一个网站同时具备CSPT+api接口url跳转漏洞，那么此时我们可以把这个漏洞升级成一个xss漏洞。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_TOYy5wOX" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">那么我们来看看吧，怎么做？</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_MHYCxRvh" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">首先是api接口的url跳转:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_MjNtYS9x" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/redirect?url=https://example.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/redirect?url=https://example.com</a></div>
</div>
<div id="_3Eb6DbVW" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="243">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193653779-1389386938.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_7PyW7I0a" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_dKNp6_V9" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">这个url跳转，无法使用伪协议进行xss攻击。那么他的危害相对就小了，只能钓鱼。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_1UpnpTSM" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">小小的跳转，是如何和无用的CSPT配合的。</span></div>
</div>
<div id="__Vv267AX" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">让我们回到最开始CSPT的业务现场:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_eWJSBLOR" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">访问<a class="link editor-quick-editable" href="http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:9999/public/profile.html?id=1</a></span></div>
</div>
<div id="_ToYGhOtG" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">触发api接口:http://localhost:9999/api/users/1</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_b9111u05" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">response返回:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_xiJccyWx" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">{"id": 1, "name": "test", "profilePic": "/public/images/user1.jpg"}</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_NlhrTPgJ" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="124">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193707705-385315983.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_dNfJ1v2D" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">api接口的json信息，会映射到前端页面上:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_pNW414e_" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="186">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193717382-1105575505.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_PXFtWtgo" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_7Ed5pyBs" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">现在我们在api接口上发现了一个url跳转漏洞，那么此时思路就来了。我们能不能，有没有可能通过CSPT漏洞，请求api接口实现跳转，在页面上加载恶意的json返回？</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_SO8sX1sR" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">这里直接上写好的利用代码:</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_9SB26FjE" class="editor-block code-block empty-block editor-code-highlighted" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code">
<div class="block-content">
<div id="_HtF0IwS8" class="editor-container sub-container" data-node-type="container">
<div id="_8co61GhK" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="style-token style-keyword">const<span class="editor-text-node"> express <span class="style-token style-operator">=<span class="editor-text-node"> <span class="style-token style-function">require<span class="style-token style-punctuation">(<span class="style-token style-string">'express'<span class="style-token style-punctuation">)<span class="style-token style-punctuation">;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>

<div id="_SlzWOSCQ" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="style-token style-keyword">const<span class="editor-text-node"> <span class="style-token style-constant">PORT<span class="editor-text-node"> <span class="style-token style-operator">=<span class="editor-text-node"> <span class="style-token style-number">5001<span class="style-token style-punctuation">;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>

</div>
<div id="_g9mnUEv4" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">&nbsp; console<span class="style-token style-punctuation">.<span class="style-token style-function">log<span class="style-token style-punctuation">(<span class="style-token style-template-punctuation style-string">`<span class="style-token style-string">攻击者服务（XSS 弹窗版）启动：http://localhost:<span class="style-token style-interpolation-punctuation style-punctuation">${<span class="style-token style-constant">PORT<span class="style-token style-interpolation-punctuation style-punctuation">}<span class="style-token style-template-punctuation style-string">`<span class="style-token style-punctuation">)<span class="style-token style-punctuation">;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
</div>
<div id="__sjzeiMi" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="style-token style-punctuation">}<span class="style-token style-punctuation">)<span class="style-token style-punctuation">;</span></span></span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_WtUgcJNg" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_NsQp4tUn" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">远程服务器上使用node启动:</span></div>
</div>

<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">GET</span></div>

<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="style-token style-punctuation">&lt;<span class="editor-text-node">h2<span class="style-token style-punctuation">&gt;<span class="editor-text-node">用户信息<span class="style-token style-punctuation">&lt;/<span class="editor-text-node">h2<span class="style-token style-punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>

<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="style-token style-punctuation">&lt;<span class="editor-text-node">p<span <div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; `;</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_dwXZLjWy" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_4btB4r1C" class="editor-block embed-block image-embed block-align-center embed-caret-full embed-selected" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="embed" data-tmp-img-width="574" data-tmp-img-height="172">
<div class="embed-container embed-container-image block-content">
<div class="editor-images-container editor-embed" data-node-type="embed" data-embed-type="image">
<div class="editor-image-content">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1090320/202511/1090320-20251102193826868-849283949.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_TtPeS7ct" class="editor-block text-block editor-compositing" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">通过url跳转伪造页面，实现渲染了用户植入的恶意代码。<span class="editor-composition">​ </span></span></div>
</div>
<div id="_w5dXn8wZ" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">总结，要实现xss漏洞，我们需要必须条件？</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_jWYyO1qF" class="editor-block code-block empty-block editor-code-highlighted" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code">
<div class="block-content">
<div id="_hd6dOWir" class="editor-container sub-container" data-node-type="container">
<div id="_XchmGM_X" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">1.支持CSPT特性</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_FECyaReW" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">2.api接口存在url跳转漏洞</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_SKszUYyf" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">3.页面支持innerHTMl或者document.write输出。</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_gPv_ci0J" class="editor-block text-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">这里选择了伪造id参数，id一般是数据库的key，是不可控的，即使是存在危险sink，也是无法xss，但是这里巧妙的利用了CSPT+url跳转漏洞实现了xss攻击。</span></div>
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="block-content text-element"><strong><span class="editor-text-node">漏洞修复方案:</span></strong></div>
<div id="_NYvzjKPz" class="editor-block code-block empty-block editor-code-highlighted" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code">
<div class="block-content">
<div id="_JRoC7suj" class="editor-container sub-container" data-node-type="container">
<div id="_Q7MoZs8s" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">1.waf拦截../</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_AHfdtWPq" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">2.用 “资源唯一标识” 替代 “路径参数”</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_uaBULQvY" class="editor-block code-line-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div id="_A3A4i2K9" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">前端：参数不拼路径，拼前先做过滤；</span></div>
</div>
<div id="_CCVtF_Pa" class="editor-block code-line-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="code-line">
<div class="block-content text-element"><span class="editor-text-node">后端：格式权限双验，白名单锁范围。</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="_OK8ztVfo" class="editor-block text-block empty-block" data-node-type="block" data-block-type="text">
